messages:
Nora Blake: Hi team - onboarding snag. Clicking the Okta link redirects me to a 'no matching account' page. I used my legal name (nora.blake@redwood.com) on the offer but my Google account is nora.baker@gmail.com (maiden name). Also my Mac hasn't finished the MDM enrollment so I can't open the company browser profile. Who do I ping for the fastest temp access?

Kai (IT): Welcome Nora! Two parallel things: 1) MDM needs to finish before the company profile will accept SSO redirects, 2) the Google name mismatch can confuse the identity chooser. Quick unblock: can you access personal email? I can share a provisional Drive link there and reprovision an Okta invite to nora.baker+work@gmail.com. Also confirm whether you have phone MFA or a hardware key.

Nora Blake: I can use nora.baker@gmail.com. I only have phone MFA. MDM says "pending" on setup assistant. I can't install Chrome extensions on this laptop until MDM completes.

Ruth (People Ops): Nora, I approved the 1Password seat (ticket #76542). Kai, pls ensure the new alias is in the new-hires group so seats sync. Samir, can you confirm manager approval for Drive access?

Samir (Hiring Manager): Confirmed. Welcome Nora! Grant view access to the onboarding folder.

Kai (IT): Done: reprovisioned invite to nora.baker+work@gmail.com and shared a provisional Drive folder to that personal address (Viewer). Also kicked the directory sync and flagged MDM enrollment as high priority. Onboarding Bot created ticket #76543 for IT:mdm.

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #76543 created -> IT:mdm assigned to Kai. ETA 4 hours.

Nora Blake: I received the Drive link and the 1Password invite. Quick Q: once MDM finishes, will I need to re-enroll MFA or will my phone be preserved?

Kai (IT): Your phone MFA is tied to the Okta account and will persist when the canonical account is activated. For hardware keys you typically re-register under the canonical workspace profile. After MDM is done we'll run a final sync and confirm your primary email. If you hit the Okta "account chooser" again, try an incognito window or explicitly sign out of accounts.google.com first.

Nora Blake: Got it. Thanks all ":wave:". I'll watch for the MDM update and ping if anything else breaks.
